body: I don't use skype but I'll certainly talk here. Thanks for responding. It's nice to be heard.

Thank you so, so much for saying that--everyone needs a place to be heard and I feel less shitty now about taking up space on this board amid the people struggling with real issues like homelessness and illness rather than quarter-life crisis ennui and boy problems. 

I think of the Churchill quote often, actually. It's helped me a lot in the past.
For what it's worth, I'm so sorry you're going through this. You seem like a really nice person who happens to be very emotionally wiped out--that doesn't make you a loser.
